name: Glitter Scientific Network Workbench
description: A graph-first evidence workbench for pathogen-genomics resources and provenance.

layout.desktop: 56px application bar; 255px node rail; fluid graph; 320px inspector; 29px status line
layout.mobile: stacked search and 58dvh graph with a fixed 56dvh bottom inspector

principles: The populated knowledge graph is the primary interface.
Search, filters and a keyboard-operable index provide redundant access to every node.
Selection isolates one-hop context and reveals directed predicate labels.
Provenance and licensing remain attached to imported records.
Metadata relationships and verified assertions are visually distinct.
